description: This file defines the NotEqualsOperator class used for filtering operations in the SuiteCRM JSON API, specifically implementing a 'not equals' comparison operator with methods for filter and SQL representations.

classes.name: NotEqualsOperator
classes.description: A class representing the 'not equals' comparison operator for filtering in SuiteCRM's JSON API.

methods.name: toFilterOperator
methods.description: Returns the filter operator tag 'ne' for 'not equals'.

methods.name: toSqlOperator
methods.description: Returns the SQL operator '!=' for 'not equals'.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates that the provided operator is a string and checks its validity via parent class.
